title: Serre's mass formula for totally ramified local-field extensions
abstract: Proves both of Serre's mass formulas for totally ramified separable extensions of a nonarchimedean local field of any positive degree, together with the discriminant bound, tame-ramification criterion, finiteness dichotomy, convergence, and automorphism-weighted orbit count. The proof develops Eisenstein monogenicity, quantitative Newton-Hensel lifting, local constancy of root counts, and Haar measures of lattices over discrete valuation rings.

informal.MassFormula.tsum_one_div_q_pow_c: For every nonarchimedean local field K with residue-field cardinality q and every positive integer n, the sum of q^(-c(L)) over the totally ramified degree-n subextensions L of a separable closure of K is n, where c(L) is the discriminant exponent minus n plus one.
informal.MassFormula.tsum_one_div_w_mul_q_pow_c: For every nonarchimedean local field K, positive n, and set of representatives of K-isomorphism classes of totally ramified separable degree-n extensions, the sum of 1/(|Aut_K(L)| q^c(L)) is one.
informal.MassFormula.sigma_infinite_iff: For positive n, the set of totally ramified separable degree-n subextensions is infinite exactly when K and its residue field have the same characteristic p and p divides n.
informal.MassFormula.sub_one_le_d: For positive n, the discriminant exponent of a totally ramified degree-n extension is at least n-1.
informal.MassFormula.c_eq_zero_iff: For positive n and a totally ramified degree-n extension, the wild discriminant exponent vanishes exactly when the residue characteristic does not divide n.
informal.MassFormula.summable_one_div_q_pow_c: For positive n, the real-valued series of the unweighted mass terms is summable.
informal.MassFormula.ncard_isomorphic_mul_w: For a nonarchimedean local field K and a totally ramified separable extension L of positive degree n, the number of K-isomorphic copies of L inside a separable closure, multiplied by |Aut_K(L)|, is n.
